description: This Java class `PlanetAdapter` is a RecyclerView adapter used to display a list of planet names in a navigation drawer menu. It manages creating and binding view holders containing TextViews and handles item click events via a listener interface.

classes.name: PlanetAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of planets in the drawer menu, managing view creation, binding data, and handling click events.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: Custom ViewHolder class holding a TextView for each planet item.

methods.name: PlanetAdapter(String[] myDataset, OnItemClickListener listener)
methods.description: Constructor initializing dataset and click listener.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder(ViewGroup parent, int viewType)
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances by inflating the layout and initializing the TextView.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder(ViewHolder holder, int position)
methods.description: Binds the dataset item to the ViewHolder and sets up the click listener.

methods.name: getItemCount()
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the dataset.
